name: San Jose
notes: San Jose: the city series is the FHFA all-transactions index for San Jose-Sunnyvale-Santa Clara, CA (FHFA area code 41940), quarterly from 1985 Q1; the full history from the first published quarter is the long-history chart. Districts are Zillow's monthly home values (ZHVI: all homes, middle tier, smoothed, seasonally adjusted; a modelled value, not transaction prices) for 59 ZIP codes and 108 neighborhoods in the metro, shown as quarterly medians; Zillow's metro and the principal city are comparison rows. Zillow terms restrict reuse; credited, removable. Index levels are not comparable across areas: each series is rebased to 100 in the base period.
